title: Ing Dam a mekasira king metung a kayarian
intro: Metung a gabun a maki ilug a mamagus, aduang hardin a berde, at alang kapantas a kasaganaan — dapot ding manuknangan karin meragul lang alang pansin king Metung a migbendisyun karela. Inyang datang la reng paganaka a mamaus karela, linawe la. Ing tinuki metung yang parusa na angga ngeni mag-echo ya bilang babala. ninu ya ining minunang komunidad?
clues: menuknangan kami keng gabun a mapalad na ing bale mi atyu ya pilatan da reng adwang hardin.
Masaya kami kareng ilug a mamagus kareng gabun mi ampo kareng dakal a pupul a makatmu kareng kekaming pibale-bale.
Pero inyang inaus na katamu para king kapasalamatan at kapamintuan king Ginu tamu, tinalikuran tamu king kayabangan.
Ing kekaming pibandian at kapayapan gewa na kaming akalingwan ing Metung a minie ngan.
Kanita dinatang ing biglang sapa a linub king maragul a salang a kekaming panaligan.
Itamu reng memalen ning Saba', a ing gabun na kilala ya keng maragul a Ma'rib Dam.

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
